record.text:
First, PMs and Tech leads clarify requirements and edge cases; then engineers design the architecture and set the security constraints.

Agents then implement, and engineers validate the critical outputs.

This enabled five engineers to deliver the MVP in just four months.

The result: AI produced more code than their engineers could review.

The story is from the AI PDLC Playbook, which was published by @Atlassian this month.

The solution is to move the engineers before the code, but keep them afterward to validate all critical paths.

images.alt: Darkly glamorous surrealist canvas in Leonor Fini's signature aesthetic. An Indigenous North American transgender woman as Lady Liberty - statuesque, magnetically beautiful. She wears a beaded buckskin corset sculpting athletic feminine curves, a flowing silk ribbon skirt with a high side slit revealing long muscular legs and bare hips. Ochre paint traces her collarbones and midriff. Her hair forms an elaborate topknot roach fused into seven verdigris copper crown rays tipped with eagle plumes. Poised on cracked stone parapets of Belvedere Castle, she drives a flaming beacon downward, shattering an invading gothic gargoyle into stone and black smoke. Baroque chiaroscuro lighting, sweeping velvet drapery. Trans comrades and feline sphinx guardians flank her in fierce solidarity. Provocative, dominant, breathtaking triumph.
